UltraGrid 1.10.8 (tags/v1.10.8 rev 5d44e6b built Aug 24 2026 07:14:08)

[PortAudio] Using PortAudio V19.7.0-devel, revision 147dd722548358763a8b649b3e4b41dfffbcfbb6
PortAudio playback usage:
	-s portaudio:[full]help
	-r portaudio[:<index>]
or
	-r portaudio[:device=<dev>]

options:
	<dev>	device name (or a part of it); device index is also accepted here


Available PortAudio playback devices (max channels; API):
	portaudio - use default Portaudio device (marked with star)
	portaudio:1 - BlackHole 16ch (16; Core Audio)
	portaudio:2 - BlackHole 2ch (2; Core Audio)
	portaudio:3 - BlackHole 64ch (64; Core Audio)
(*) 	portaudio:5 - MacBook Pro Speakers (2; Core Audio)
	portaudio:6 - Microsoft Teams Audio (1; Core Audio)
	portaudio:7 - NDI Audio (6; Core Audio)
	portaudio:8 - ZoomAudioDevice (2; Core Audio)
	portaudio:9 - AggregateDevice (18; Core Audio)

Examples:
	vendor/ultragrid/active/uv-qt.app/Contents/MacOS/uv-real -r portaudio:d="MacBook Pro"
Exit
